extracted.name: Dill and Shrimp Salad
extracted.description: This creamy shrimp salad with dill is great to serve at a picnic, on its own or inside fresh pita bread. It is easy to prepare and tastes delicious.
instruction_lines: Combine shrimp, green onions, celery, mayonnaise, lemon juice, lime juice, dill, and pepper in a large bowl. Mix well and refrigerate until chilled.
